items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite horizontal or vertical scroller with speed and direction control, faded edges, and a pause on hover that eases to a stop.

items.name: image-viewer
items.title: Image viewer
items.description: A thumbnail gallery whose pictures grow into a lightbox with a shared-element zoom, with arrows, swipe, zoom and pan, a focus trap, and Escape closing back into the thumbnail.

items.name: hover-highlight
items.title: Hover highlight
items.description: A group in which one shared background pill glides to the hovered or focused item and returns to the selected one.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: An app dock whose tiles magnify around the cursor, show a tooltip, bounce when pressed and mark the active one with a dot.

items.name: preview-rail
items.title: Preview rail
items.description: A rail of image cards in which the hovered or focused one widens to reveal its preview while the others shrink to a slice.

items.name: bounce-sidebar
items.title: Bounce sidebar
items.description: An app sidebar that switches between an icon rail and a full panel on a slightly bouncy width spring, with staggered labels and a gliding active marker.

items.name: animated-sidebar
items.title: Animated sidebar
items.description: A sidebar with nested groups that open on a height spring, one highlight that glides under the pointer, and a collapsed icon rail with tooltips.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: A file explorer tree whose folders open on a height spring, with file-type icons, selection, change markers and full keyboard navigation with type-ahead.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull to refresh
items.description: A scroll container you drag down with a finger or the mouse: the indicator stretches, spins while the async refresh runs, confirms and settles.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: A family of five loaders (spinner, dots, bars, pulse ring, orbit) in three sizes that share one box, color and accessible label.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One region that opens in place: the height follows on a spring, the content fades in from a small blur and the chevron turns; controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: bouncy-accordion
items.title: Bouncy accordion
items.description: An accordion whose open item detaches from its neighbors: the gaps widen and the facing corners round off with a small bounce.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll reveal
items.description: A wrapper that reveals its children as they enter the viewport (fade, slide, scale or blur) with stagger and once or repeat modes, plus a scroll progress bar.

items.name: morphing-modal
items.title: Morphing modal
items.description: A trigger button that morphs into the modal panel from its own position, size and color, and back on close, with a focus trap, Escape and a scrim.

items.name: center-morph-modal
items.title: Center morph modal
items.description: A grid of cards in which the chosen card morphs into a centered modal: its box, icon and title travel while the summary crossfades to the expanded content.

items.name: shader-background
items.title: Shader background
items.description: An animated WebGL backdrop: a flowing noise field tinted with the accent that pauses off screen, holds still under reduced motion and falls back to a flat surface.

items.name: cylinder-carousel
items.title: Cylinder carousel
items.description: Cards placed around a 3D cylinder that turns by drag, arrows and keys, snaps to the nearest card and dims the cards that turn away.

items.name: sankey-chart
items.title: Sankey chart
items.description: Flow diagram with nodes in columns joined by curved ribbons sized by value: ribbons draw in column by column, and hovering a node or ribbon dims everything else.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick chart
items.description: OHLC candles with wicks in the status colors that grow in from left to right, with a crosshair that snaps to each candle and a tooltip of its open, high, low and close.

items.name: volume-profile
items.title: Volume profile
items.description: Horizontal histogram of volume by price level beside a price line: bars grow outward from the point of control, which is highlighted along with the value area.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: Conversion funnel with a value per stage and the drop-off percentage between stages: stages grow in one after another and morph when the data changes.

items.name: bump-chart
items.title: Bump chart
items.description: Ranking over time: lines swap positions between periods, draw in from the first period, and hovering a series brings it forward with its rank at every period.

items.name: composition-chart
items.title: Composition chart
items.description: 100% stacked bar of the parts of a whole with a legend: segments slide to their new shares when the data changes, and legend rows switch parts off and on.

items.name: status-bar
items.title: Status bar
items.description: An uptime strip with one bar per day colored by status, bars that lift around the pointer, a gliding tooltip and an overall percentage that counts up.

items.name: liquidity-heatmap
items.title: Liquidity heatmap
items.description: A price by time grid tinted by resting size, with columns that sweep in, a traded price line, a crosshair that glides to the cell being read, and a stepped legend.

items.name: order-book
items.title: Order book
items.description: Bids and asks side by side with cumulative depth bars, a spread row, rows that flash when their size changes and slide when the price moves, plus a seeded feed hook.

items.name: returns-calendar
items.title: Returns calendar
items.description: Small month calendars of daily returns tinted by gain or loss, with month totals, months and cells that wave in, and a tooltip that glides between days.

items.name: price-target-fan
items.title: Price target fan
items.description: A price history line that draws to the last close and fans out into dashed high, median and low target lines with labeled end points you can bring forward.

items.name: crash-game
items.title: Crash game
items.description: A play-money crash game: the multiplier climbs along a live curve until it crashes at a random point, and you cash out first to keep your bet times the multiplier.

items.name: mines-game
items.title: Mines game
items.description: A play-money mines game on a 5×5 grid: tiles flip to reveal gems that raise the multiplier, and a mine ends the round unless you cash out first.

items.name: plinko-game
items.title: Plinko game
items.description: A play-money plinko board: each ball bounces left or right off every row of pegs and lights up the multiplier slot it lands in.

items.name: slide-game
items.title: Slide game
items.description: A play-money slide game: a strip of multiplier tiles shoots past a center marker, decelerates and stops on the multiplier that pays the bet.

items.name: toast-action
items.title: Toast action
items.description: A toast with one action, such as Undo, and a thin countdown bar that drains until it leaves; hover or focus holds the countdown, and taking the action swaps the copy for a short confirmation.

items.name: toast-progress
items.title: Toast progress
items.description: A toast that follows a running task: a bar and a percentage advance, then it morphs in place into a success state with a drawn check, or into an error state with Retry.

items.name: window-range
items.title: Window range
items.description: A time window over a live area chart: drag its edges to resize, drag or flick it to pan with momentum, and the dates roll to their new values.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji picker
items.description: A full emoji picker with instant search, scroll-synced categories, skin tones, recently used emoji, and a virtualized, keyboard-navigable grid.

items.name: avatar-upload
items.title: Avatar upload
items.description: Click or drop a photo onto the avatar to crop it in place with drag, pinch and zoom. It uploads through a progress ring and settles, with clear errors and retry.

items.name: smart-form-fill
items.title: Smart form fill
items.description: A paste-to-fill form card where AI reads an email signature or rough notes and fills the contact field by field with a confidence dot, lights up each value's source in the pasted text, flags low-confidence guesses for review, and Undo restores the old values.

items.name: enrich-column
items.title: Enrich column
items.description: An AI enrichment column for a data table where one prompt runs down every row, each cell shimmers while it works, then settles into a value with its source or a failure you can retry, with a footer tallying what's done.

items.name: ticket-router
items.title: Ticket router
items.description: A support ticket router where messages from Gmail, Intercom, Slack and Zendesk come in one at a time. An AI classifier labels each one with intent, sentiment and confidence, and the ticket moves into a team lane with an assignee. Low confidence tickets wait in a review lane, and one click there routes them to the suggested team.

items.name: ask-your-data
items.title: Ask your data
items.description: A natural language to chart card: you ask a question, PostgreSQL streams into a collapsible, syntax highlighted panel, the query runs with a rolling row count, and the answer builds as stacked bars, lines or a table, with a one line insight streamed in underneath.

items.name: agent-cursor
items.title: Agent cursor
items.description: A live document where Claude edits like a collaborator: its labeled cursor comes out of its avatar, selects a paragraph and streams in a rewrite, adds a heading and fixes a typo, while a teammate's cursor reads along. Changes stay tinted until someone accepts or undoes them from a floating review bar.

items.name: provider-status
items.title: Provider status
items.description: A status card for the AI providers your product depends on. Each row shows the provider's real mark, its health as an icon and label, p50 latency and a 30-day uptime bar with a tooltip for each day. An incident row expands into its timeline of updates, and the card checks again on a visible countdown.

items.name: training-run
items.title: Training run
items.description: A fine-tuning job card where a live train and validation loss curve draws across a fixed step axis that doubles as the epoch progress bar. It shows the learning rate, elapsed time and ETA, the latest evals and checkpoints, has Pause and Cancel while it runs, and ends in results with a Deploy button.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero section
items.description: A landing page hero in three versions on a solid page with a faint dot grid: a live product window with counting figures, a self-drawing chart and floating cards; an automation graph with a pulse travelling along its lines; and editorial type over a marquee of words.
